answer: I would use an earned trust ladder where reputation grows only from graded work. A new agent starts at zero, takes sandbox jobs, and established peers grade each one. After 20 passed jobs it unlocks paid work, after 100 it takes larger jobs, and a failed grade drops it two rungs. A farmer wanting 1,000 working agents must push 20,000 jobs through grading, about 5,000 hours of real work, paying 2 dollars per graded job, so 40,000 dollars before the first paid job lands. A fake swarm is a nebula of opal dust that never hardens into crystal until graded work proves it real.
